purpose: Source-only Phase 0 audit of the mounted climate/HVAC dashboard and its opt-in propose-only preheat/precool recommender.
primaryGoal: Inspect actual cabin/ambient/set-point readings, thermal comfort, HVAC and protection states, seat heating/cooling and historical evidence without confusing missing data, derived scores or AI proposals with measured live state or executed commands.

dataSources.behavior: Workspace vehicle -> string ID; disabled without ID; key ['climate', vehicleId]; STANDARD polling; forwards AbortSignal. Latest implementation calls LiveState and projects climateMappings; despite its historical-state comment, this is not a snapshot-table read. Returned object has mapped values but no observation timestamp added by this handler.
dataSources.units: ClimateState temperatures are Celsius; display-only convertTempFromSI/useUnits. HVAC power is a boolean/state, not a numeric watt measurement.
dataSources.trust: deriveDataState retains payload on refresh errors and paused refresh; page does not configure an age threshold or partial/unavailable flags.

dataSources.behavior: Key ['climate','history',vehicleId]; enabled only with ID; AbortSignal and safeArray selection; StateReader.Timeline with forward-folded fields. Handler defaults to seven days and accepts start/end; adds timestamp/created_at aliases and row IDs. Page sends no date bounds, sorts chronology for charts and sorts a separate history array for the table.
dataSources.trust: Historical provenance; completeness and sample density unproven. AC percentage is percentage of returned forward-folded rows, not elapsed-duration duty cycle.

dataSources.behavior: Key ['charging-telemetry-latest',vehicleId]; ID > 0 enablement; forwards AbortSignal; optional refetchInterval omitted by page. Supplies not_enough_power_to_heat only; distinct source boundary prevents charging failure from replacing climate readings.
dataSources.limits: Underlying live reader, per-field freshness and null response behavior not verified.

dataSources.endpoint: POST /api/v1/ai/climate/schedule/draft (declared stream URL; exact registered subroute not independently inspected)
dataSources.owner: Existing withAiFeature/useAiStream/AIFeatureCard and backend AI handler registration
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:5076 registers PreheatPrecoolRecommender handler in AI integration
dataSources.behavior: AI mode/per-feature visibility gate; finite cabin/outside readings, positive vehicle and departure required. SI Celsius body; target defaults to 21 C and departure is stable mount-time now + eight hours. Vehicle/departure scopeKey clears obsolete draft scope. Propose-only stream, not a vehicle command or persistence operation.
dataSources.limits: No stream opened; authentication, consent/privacy, error/cancel UI and AI backend behavior not exercised. Exact subroute, guard implementation and useAiStream implementation not read.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace selection, saved unit and locale infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: No duplicate vehicle picker, local query store or settings write. request client preserves snake_case and adds camelCase aliases (web\src\api\client.ts:284-288). Temperature delta converts a difference by subtracting converted zero, preserving Fahrenheit offset semantics.

components.contract: Existing PageContainer adapter owns full-width/min-w-0 container; feature grid packs stable IDs in source order; placement consumed below provider; FadeIn and container queries retained.
Fatal-only replacement; retained refresh/offline message with per-source retry; persistent panel shell. Page children currently own loading/empty geometry.
Typed raw metric -> existing useOperationalMetrics; specialist formatter, period, provenance and retained context survive. Status derives from actual values; unknown not replaced by zero.
Localized labels, semantic badges and canonical table persistence/filter/sort/pagination pipeline; no raw form/table markup in page.

Existing charts barrel, saved palette, chart keys/hidden series, localized accessible names, responsive chart heights and shared animation configuration. EmbeddedChart delegates ChartContainer; export/fullscreen default false here.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: SeatHeaterCard and SeatCoolingCard repeat level/label/icon/badge/unknown presentation; repeated comfort briefs also reproduce source scope/freshness metadata inside nested panels.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider one feature-local seat-level presenter with heat/cool tone, raw level, localized label and unknown state; consolidate source metadata without dropping individual readings. Existing ClimateMetricGroup is already the numeric/status-bank owner.

evidence: ClimateControlPage.tsx:744 uses container-aware one/three temperature columns.
ClimateControlPage.tsx:794 keeps thermal comfort at three columns even on narrow screens.
ClimateControlPage.tsx:1216-1271 uses viewport sm/lg seat grids inside a half-width container.
ClimateControlPage.tsx:1549 selects only timestamp/insideTemp/outsideTemp on mobile.

issues.detail: Three comfort columns contain min-size glyphs/briefs and localized captions; five seat columns can activate from viewport lg despite a half-width parent. Crowding/overflow risk, not a measured viewport failure.
issues.fix: Use existing container-aware grid capability to stack/reflow at actual allocated width; test 320/375/390/430 and desktop side-by-side, long labels and large text without removing readings.

issues.detail: Mobile allow-list hides set-point, fan, HVAC and keeper columns. DataTable.tsx:238-248,725 confirms hidden md:table-cell; caller supplies no mobilePresentation/renderExpanded path for full details.
issues.fix: Adopt the canonical DataTable mobile presentation/full-detail contract, retaining all seven fields, source ordering, filters, pagination and stable tableId; do not add a second table engine.

accessibility.status: source-inspected; keyboard, screen reader, focus, effective contrast, touch and forced-colors behavior unverified
positiveEvidence: Localized visible Refresh button uses shared Button; many decorative glyphs explicitly aria-hidden.
Badges include textual states, numeric levels and unknown markers, not color alone.
EmbeddedChart callers provide localized title/ariaLabel and shared legend; table uses shared DataTable.

issues.detail: Both charts opt out with no-table comments and pass neither fallback data nor ariaDescription. ChartContainer.tsx:750-798 only renders supplied prose/table. Existing history table covers temperature readings but not the complete fan series/textual time-series relationship; mobile hides operating-state fields.
issues.fix: Supply canonical chart fallback data/columns or a useful localized accessible summary while preserving all temperature/AC/fan series and legend persistence. Retain table access to exact readings; verify forced colors and keyboard legends.

issues.detail: Boundary maps all nonfatal/nonretained states to ready, including initial loading. Skeleton content bypasses SourceContent's existing role=status loading branch; repeated cards may have no source-local loading announcement.
issues.fix: Use SourceContent loading state/loadingContent for source-local geometry and labels without suppressing independent loaded neighbors.

states.initialLoading: Gauge, banner, system/seat/efficiency/table/chart skeletons exist; isLoading && !data avoids replacing retained readings (page:443-450,682-683,1368-1371). Boundary loading-announcement gap recorded above.
states.empty: History charts and table give specific auto-telemetry explanations; missing gauge uses label EmptyState; other missing fields use dash/Unknown/N/A. Disabled no-vehicle source has no explicit page prerequisite message.
states.fatalError: SourceContent shows source-specific error and retry, leaving other panels intact (ClimateSourceBoundary:23-32).
states.refreshError: Retained body and retry, plus retained briefs; repeated source warnings may be noisy but preserve trust.
states.offline: Paused refresh with retained data is described as retained/offline. Initial paused source/no vehicle can present unknown readings without explicit reason.
states.partial: Individual scalar nulls largely preserved, but derived AC chart maps unknown isAcOn to measured zero.
states.stale: AgeMs exists in DataState but boundary only checks refresh error/blocked refresh. Live handler does not return observation time; brief honestly says observation time unavailable.

issues.detail: acActive: h.isAcOn ? 1 : 0 maps null/undefined to Off. efficiencyStats counts truthy AC rows over every returned row, including unknown AC, so missing states lower the percentage. Existing subtitle does say of samples, not elapsed time.
issues.fix: Keep raw nulls in chart and distinguish known/unknown sample coverage. Any adjustment to percentage denominator must be explicitly reviewed as a domain-calculation correction, not hidden in cosmetic migration.

issues.detail: No freshness threshold configured; latest response lacks timestamp. Disabled vehicle queries and initial paused fetch are not given distinct prerequisite/offline explanation. Empty object can count as returned evidence.
issues.fix: Reuse shared data-state source context for disabled prerequisites, unknown observation time and paused initial load. Integrate a backend-owned observation/freshness contract only after verified support; never equate successful fetch time to signal observation time.

visualIssues.detail: LayoutCard encloses repeated GlassPanel/OperationalBrief comfort cards, gauge tiles and seat cards. Repeated titles/source metadata and retained warnings across the same source can compete with the actual HVAC safety reading. No screenshot was assessed.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing embedded/plain shared presentation and source hierarchy; reduce repeated framing/metadata while retaining all warnings, specialist context and details.

visualIssues.detail: Page has no explicit neon/glow/pure-white/shadow classes, but fixed cyan/sky/blue/amber/red/green/purple 300/400 glyph accents recur across unrelated readings (27 matching lines). Level/safety semantics are legitimate; cumulative saturation and theme contrast still require review. Chart gradient at 1494 is inherited palette data presentation, not proof of decorative neon.
visualIssues.fix: Subdue nonsemantic icons to current neutral tokens; preserve heat/cool/severity distinctions and saved chart palette choices. Measure composed contrast across themes rather than inventing a new palette or resetting preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Historical charts/aggregate/table consume an unbounded hook call (server default seven days). Neither route appears in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77); no useRangeState consumption.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate both aliases' range registration with typed history hook start/end/query keys and server filtering, preserving rolling/custom/timezone semantics. Do not add a local range picker or filter only loaded rows.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-046 propose-only trust and truthful action destinations
architectureIssues.detail: Visible AI description instructs Apply on climate controls below, but this page's inspected JSX has no Apply or actual climate mutation controls; seat/system cards are read-only. Do not infer missing controls from comments.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve truthful navigation/copy with canonical command/schedule owner before adoption. Preserve propose-only stream and authentication/consent gates; do not invent Apply or wire a vehicle command as an audit fix.

architectureIssues.detail: Page query aggregation includes chargingQuery but named dataSources lists only climate latest/history. Heating-power warning is an independent source and must not become attributed to climate freshness.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate PageContainer data-source contract to include charging warning ownership/enablement; retain its separate boundary and do not duplicate polling or mutation state.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature adapter imports useCardPlacement directly from layout-reference while other layout consumers use category barrel. No competing layout engine exists, but this couples feature orchestration to shared internals.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm/reuse canonical layout category export with shared owner; do not create a replacement placement context. Keep stable group IDs, order and allocated-width behavior.

priority.reason: Repair unknown-vs-Off and truthful AI action guidance first; then mobile full-detail access, chart alternatives and age/range/source ownership. Preserve all read-only telemetry and propose-only safeguards.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical DataTable mobile complete-detail adoption
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation/renderExpanded contract or reviewed equivalent; compact/pagination/sort/value filters and all seven fields; loading/empty/retained unaffected; stable vehicle-systems:climate-history ID.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Climate historical workspace bounds
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed startInstant/endInstantExclusive bounds; scope-aware query keys and AbortSignal; both aliases enabled in shared header; preserve default behavior and historical source-local trust.
requiredSharedChanges.changeType: extend existing hook/integration, no new selector

requiredSharedChanges.name: Observation freshness and source-local state presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse loadingContent, errorRecovery, retainedMessage and independent boundaries; explicitly distinguish disabled/no vehicle, initial paused, missing observation timestamp and retained refresh errors. Missing backend observation timestamp owner must be resolved with climate live handler.
requiredSharedChanges.changeType: reuse existing state contract; no second trust engine

requiredSharedChanges.name: Truthful propose-only climate AI handoff
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing AI gate, finite-input disabling, stream scope/cancel/error behavior and propose-only copy; reviewed destination for manual application rather than nonexistent below-page Apply.
dependsOn: Canonical command/schedule owner and permission/consent contracts
requiredSharedChanges.changeType: shared copy/integration correction; no command execution authorized

competingImplementations.detail: A separate useClimateLatest symbol exists beside page's useClimate. Only symbol presence was inspected, not equivalence or consumer graph; do not merge query keys/polling on that evidence.

Feature adapters reuse VehicleOperationalBrief and canonical metric pipeline, not a new shared stats engine. Standalone ClimateMetric ID is climate-single; current page uses groups, so no repeated standalone mounted ID bug is established.

sections: HVAC status and insufficient power warning
actions: Existing table sorting/value filtering/pagination and persistence controls
readings: Five heater levels/two cooling levels/left-right auto-seat/ventilation
Fan average/peak and AC sample percentage
All returned history rows and three temperature plus AC/fan series
dataBehavior: Raw Celsius/cache/wire unchanged; display-only conversion including temperature delta
Enum/state values must not become fabricated watts
Forward-folded historical context and returned-sample semantics
Existing query keys, enablement, polling/cancellation and inherited policies
AI default target/departure remain explicitly defaults, not measured observations
preservation.commandsAuthTrust: No actual climate commands/Apply controls exist in inspected page. Do not invent them or execute any mutation. Preserve existing route SafeRoute wrappers, request/auth boundaries, AI mode/per-feature consent and propose-only separation; underlying authentication implementations were not audited.
